plan: My value is $25. In a first-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy depends on predicting others' behavior. I'll bid strategically between my value and slightly above the expected average bid, balancing winning probability with profit margin. A bid around $22-$26 seems reasonable to maximize expected profit.
